newsitem.title: USA: Midland hires investment banker for merger.
newsitem.headline: Midland hires investment banker for merger.

text.p: Midland Resources said Monday it hired First Union Capital Markets Corp as its exclusive representative to find potential merger candidates.

Company President Deas Warley said the merger candidate would bring the "needed additional financial strength to allow the combined entity to enhance the growth rate and potential for the shareholders of both companies."

Warley said the company spent $5.93 million in land, seismic, exploratory, and development drilling in the last 18 months. He added the company drilled nine exploratory wells resulting in six discoveries and three dry holes and successfully completed four development wells and is drilling a development well in the Latigo Project.

"We estimate the successful discoveries coupled with seismic data indicate the potential for approximately 38 development locations in addition to the company's existing inventory of development drilling locations," Warley said.
Midland's stock rose 3/8 to 4 Monday afternoon.
